title: GUNS FIRST ON THE EXTRACTED CARD
why: his order 10-27: on the extracted screen always show guns first, the best thing to extract, regardless of rarity
now: guns lead the haul on the extracted card

edits.replacement: keys.sort(function(a,b){ return (((ITEMS[b]&&ITEMS[b].use==='gun')?1:0)-((ITEMS[a]&&ITEMS[a].use==='gun')?1:0))||(ival(b)-ival(a)); });   // v35.xx (cw-gunsfirst), HIS ORDER (2026-10-27): "on the extracted screen, always show guns first, that's the best thing to extract, regardless of color/rarity". Guns lead the strip, the dearest gun first, so a gun is never cut by the eight tile cap; everything after them keeps the value order. The reveal still runs right to left, so the guns land last.
